purpose: Scoping inventory for plans.json item test-strategy-consolidate-to-etudes-suites. Classifies all 210 tests/*.py files (excluding tests/_notebook_exec_helpers.py) per the user's rule: keep pure-function/numerical/invariant tests a notebook run can't exercise, retire candidates that mainly re-exercise API call chains already/easily covered by real etude/suite notebook execution.
rule: Keep pure-function unit tests, retire the rest (user decision, 2026-07-02).
method: 5 parallel classification passes (42 files each) by independent subagents, each reading module docstring + test function names + skimming 1-2 representative test bodies per file before bucketing. No files were deleted in this pass -- classification only.

buckets.KEEP: pure-function/numerical invariant, dtype/NaN/Inf/edge-case guard, pytree round-trip, JSON/schema validation, or public-API-contract/snapshot a notebook run cannot exercise
buckets.RETIRE-CANDIDATE: primarily exercises an API call chain (construct/simulate/probe/objective/etc.) already or easily coverable by executing a real etude/suite notebook end-to-end
buckets.KEEP-INFRA: is the notebook-execution gate mechanism itself, or a repo-hygiene/doc-consistency/release-process check unrelated to the scientific/API surface
buckets.UNSURE: file mixes categories or is genuinely ambiguous -- needs a human split/read before acting

summary_counts.note: sums to ~207/210; batch 2's own count summary undercounted by ~3 relative to its table rows -- table rows are authoritative, this is a reporting artifact not a data-loss issue

important_findings: SanityDelta test cluster (test_sanity_delta_backup_resume.py, test_sanity_delta_full_runtime_mode.py, test_sanity_delta_plasticity.py, test_sanity_delta_plasticity_report_full.py, test_sanity_delta_proxy_readout_names.py, test_sanity_delta_report_schema_full.py, test_sanity_delta_task_schedule.py, test_simulate_runtime_propagation.py, test_source_bookkeeping_v020.py) exercises a hierarchical-oddball paradigm chain via a real notebook on disk (tutorials/jaxfne-sanity-delta-test-hierarchical-global-local-oddball.ipynb) that is NOT in tests/test_notebook_execution_suite.py's RELEASE_FACING_NOTEBOOKS list. Retiring these RETIRE-CANDIDATE-classified files without first adding that notebook to the execution gate would silently drop coverage of that code path. BLOCKS retirement of that cluster until resolved.

Several files are internally mixed (part KEEP, part RETIRE-CANDIDATE) and were marked UNSURE rather than force-bucketed: test_fields_projection_finite_and_normalization.py, test_interactive_tutorial_artifacts_v0221.py, test_config_plasticity_homeostasis_baseline.py, test_artifact_json_safety_v0330.py, test_delta_notebook_01_static.py, test_ed9_evidence.py, test_ed9_hdp_evidence.py, test_optim_jax_native_audit.py, test_plasticity_v034.py, test_public_builders_complete.py, test_tutorial_utils.py, test_v036_100_neuron_ei_population_tutorial.py, test_scaling_benchmark.py, test_suite_no1_public_grammar_validation.py, test_suite_no4_runtime_static_guards.py. These need per-test-function splitting (extract the KEEP-worthy tests into a smaller file or a shared conftest, retire the rest) rather than a whole-file verdict.
